summary: Petrol this week (from 23 Nov) is NT$32.7/L for 95 and 31.2 for 92, per CPC's own page, unchanged for seven weeks; in January it was about 5 NTD lower (95 at 27.9). Official lab tests give about 60-66 km/L for mainstream 125cc scooters, so fuel is about NT$0.55 per km in the lab and NT$0.65-0.95 in real use (unverified owner estimates of 35-50 km/L). Home charging at current 台電 tariffs (1.78 to 2.26 per kWh in low tiers, as reported by two media outlets) costs roughly NT$0.06-0.08 per km, up to about 0.19 in higher tiers, assuming 31.4 km/kWh from one operator. The December tariff review may raise rates. Annual distance and independent cost-of-ownership data could not be found, so the calculator is our own arithmetic. MOTC survey data show electric owners spending more, mainly on battery rental.
